revisionDesc.change: Submit - Entered published corrections to lines 28, 30, 50, 59, 65, 67, 78, 83, 92, 101.

Entered Greek text from P.Sijp.36; lin16: <#δ=1/4#> because of editors singular κ(εράτιον), but not clear why lin17 has also the singular form, because δ, followed by the "half"-symbol normally should stand for "4"; lin21: number after (κ(εράτια)) .2[.?] can be either <#.1=#> <#.1=#> <#[.?]=#> or <#.2=#> <#[.?]=#> or even slanting strokes could be assumed in the gap; lin22: same problem as in lin21; lin23, 24: doubt whether δ is 4 or 1/4; lin66: (|[.?].3|) contains probably two names/words, but impossible to know where the division should be made; lin82: dot after singular [(vό(μισμα))] only can be <#α=1#>; lin83: added closing bracket; impossible to see whether number is <#.1[.?]=#> or <#.1=#> <#[.?]=#>; lin93: four dots to designate the number before δ (=1/4) seem to me inexplicable; perhaps two slanting strokes and a number consisting of two dots?; lin100: seemed to me the most logical to divide the four dots into <#.2=#> <#.1=#> <#.1=#>
